svg.title: How a request is routed
svg.desc: PugPort sends a five-part request state (message, recent context, quoted reference text, attachment metadata, candidate executors) to POST /v1/judge. The service runs one inference at a time with a queue of 8; the mmBERT encoder answers ten heads in one pass. PugPort uses difficulty for model tier and effort, task_type for routing category, and project_access, run_commands, browser_use and media_output to decide reply or task. On a missed deadline or error it falls back to rule-based routing with a 30 s back-off. A policy layer of user pins, approved rules, quotas, budgets and read-only limits always wins.
